text: i am not getting t he snapping to shift when i hold a modifier
resolution: Root-caused why no modifier registered in the loader iso pane: the onKey handler matched e.key==='shift'/'alt'/'control', but the host's SDL_KEY_NAMES table (runtime/hooks/useIFTTT.ts) has NO entry for modifier keys — a modifier-only press decodes to key='sdl:1073742049', so the string comparison never matched and modRef.shift/alt/ctrl stayed false the whole time. That silently killed all three of req_1877's modifiers: SHIFT sub-grid, ALT freeform, and Ctrl-click multi-select. The real modifier state is carried in the decodeKey flags e.shiftKey/altKey/ctrlKey (derived from the SDL mod bitmask), which is exactly what the shared useHeldModifiers hook reads — so I replaced the hand-rolled useRef+key-string parsing with useHeldModifiers (the same hook IsoAuthor uses for its Alt freeform), and removed the now-dead modifier lines + cleanup reset. Cart bundles clean. This makes the req_1877 gestures actually fire; verify live by holding Shift (ghost snaps to 0.5m half-cells), Alt (freeform), Ctrl-click (toggle multi-select), double-click (whole object).
